title: eleocharis palustris var. globularis
intro: Eleocharis palustris var. globularis, commonly known as Globe Spike-rush, is a type of flowering plant in the sedge family, characterized by its globe-shaped spikelets and slender stems. Globe Spike-rush is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, soothing respiratory issues, and supporting digestive health. The therapeutic actions of this plant include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, which help to alleviate symptoms of colds, coughs, and bronchitis. The bioactive constituents of Globe Spike-rush include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
